results.title: Madeline's Curse
results.overview: Esperanza, a nurse about to retire, becomes involved in the lives of two young patients from a psychiatric center, fallen angels with opposite goals: vengeance and recovery through love.

results.title: The Suitcase
results.overview: During a gala, three friends stumble upon a suitcase filled with money and a dead body. Before they know it, they find themselves caught up in an unexpected and dangerous manhunt.

results.title: Lone' Wolves
results.overview: After hitting an animal with their car, two sisters become stranded in the woods waiting for paramedics. While repairing their relationship, a man-eating creature marks them as its next target.

results.title: Робоняня
results.overview: Cheerful and inventive Zlata, who stays at home alone for the sake of the school ball and the first kiss, under the supervision of the newest robot nanny Notrix. Confident that she can easily trick the car, Zlata soon discovers that she is dealing with an invulnerable opponent who controls the entire house. Desperate, she and her neighbor Nikita, who is in love with her, find an unconventional way out - they begin to communicate with the robot in its language, using "perfect promts". Their friendship with their iron friend is rapidly gaining momentum and leads to a huge party, which turns into real chaos. It is at this moment that Zlata has to make a choice and understand what true friendship and self-sacrifice are.

results.title: Los Poderes
results.overview: Marco is 18 years old. While his mother insists on having him admitted to a rehab clinic, he is convinced that he only needs one last chance to turn his life around.

results.title: The Boys of Dungeon Lane: In Conversation with Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal
results.original_title: The Boys of Dungeon Lane: In Conversation with Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal
results.overview: Premiering exclusively on Amazon Live and Amazon Music, this short film features an intimate conversation between Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal, exploring the memories, relationships, events and stories that inform McCartney’s forthcoming album of the same name.

results.title: The Devil in Me
results.overview: In a dusty nowhere town of the Nevada desert, a stranded drifter wins an ancient hourglass in a late-night card game, unaware that it carries a violent, soul-hungry curse. As the sand inside begins to fall, the object twists his mind and forces him toward unspeakable acts, feeding on the lives it consumes. With time running out and the line between fate and possession blurring, he must confront the evil now living inside him before the hourglass claims his soul entirely. A folk-horror western about isolation, temptation, and the cost of borrowed time.

results.title: Wild Foxes
results.overview: At a sports boarding school, talented young boxer Camille narrowly survives a fatal accident, saved by his best friend Matteo. After a swift recovery, an inexplicable pain gradually takes hold of him, threatening his dreams of greatness and his relationship with the team. In the ring and in a man's world, there’s no room for weakness.

results.title: Taxi Drivers
results.overview: A short documentary about fake cabs in Toronto and those who have been scammed by them.

results.title: Spa Day
results.overview: Trying to relax at a spa, an anxious guy can’t help but talk too much about himself.

results.title: Molder Man
results.overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

results.title: KODEN'N
results.overview: When Western medicine fails to explain a couple’s multiple miscarriages, a husband turns to his Haitian ancestry for solutions in Daniel “Tètèl” Chérubin’s restrained and mood-driven horror that leans on the importance of inherited spiritual traditions.

results.title: Rain Catcher
results.overview: In rainy, nocturnal London, photographer Miles obsessively captures unforgiving, morbid portraits of oblivious strangers. When not selling them, he shares them online as 'Rain Catcher'. But soon he notices something unsettling: a mysterious woman watching him and photographing him—turning the lens back on Miles. As her gaze closes in, his world fractures—his work is sabotaged, his name defamed, his loved ones endangered. Consumed by paranoia, he spirals into a dark, delirious obsession to uncover the truth behind her motives. Based on the 2018 short film of the same name.

results.title: The Summer That Ended Twice
results.overview: In the summer she turns 11, Alessandra discovers she can see ghosts, and decides to sacrifice everything to meet her mother, who vanished many years before.

results.title: Where the Hell Is Anna?
results.overview: When her estranged best friend Anna mysteriously vanishes into a women-only retreat in the woods, messy and heartbroken Derick crashes the culty pagan commune determined to bring her home. But the longer she stays, the harder it gets to tell who’s healing and who’s brainwashed. As the Summer Solstice nears and Anna is chosen for a “ceremony” called Induction Day, Derick uncovers disturbing secrets buried beneath the flower crowns and sisterhood mantras, including blood rituals, fertility experiments, and the looming promise of paradise known as Summerland.

results.title: BRAINCHILD
results.overview: Dr. Niall Boyd discovers a Robot he designed has begun to show signs of consciousness. He tasks his neighbor Monica Vikander to conduct a Turing test with it to prove this.

results.title: Keu Na Januk
results.overview: A young man dreams of becoming a renowned photographer instead of taking a regular job, but while his father sees him as irresponsible and unsuccessful, only his girlfriend continues to believe in him as he struggles against a series of setbacks.
